items.desc: Open-source, self-hosted AI customer service platform built around ReAct agents. Agents retrieve knowledge, call tools, and prepare actions; humans confirm high-impact writes such as ticket creation. Apache-2.0, Postgres-only.

推量牛 BullFlow — 开源企业级 RAG 解决方案：从企业知识库、营销内容自动化生产到全域内容分发 | Open-source enterprise RAG solution: knowledge base → automated marketing content → omnichannel publishing. 知识库全链路本地开源模型，无需付费模型；AI Agent 创作图文 / 图片 / 视频，一键发布抖音、小红书、公众号、LinkedIn、YouTube 等 17 个平台。Commercial-grade, multi-tenant, billing & admin built in. MIT
